description: This file contains unit tests for the SpringSecurityPlatformSecurityContext class, verifying its behavior in handling authenticated user retrieval and password reset scenarios within the security context.

classes.name: SpringSecurityPlatformSecurityContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of SpringSecurityPlatformSecurityContext.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the security context prior to each test by setting the SecurityContextHolder's context.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clears the security context after each test.

methods.name: shouldReturnAppUserWhenPrincipalIsAppUser
methods.description: Tests that the authenticatedUser() method returns the AppUser object when the principal is an AppUser.

methods.name: shouldThrowUnAuthenticatedUserExceptionWhenPrincipalIsNotAppUser
methods.description: Verifies that UnAuthenticatedUserException is thrown if the principal is not an AppUser.

methods.name: shouldThrowUnAuthenticatedUserExceptionWhenAuthenticationIsNull
methods.description: Checks that UnAuthenticatedUserException is thrown when authentication object is null.

methods.name: shouldThrowResetPasswordExceptionWhenPasswordMustBeReset
methods.description: Ensures that ResetPasswordException is thrown if the password needs to be reset.
